title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: cellspec object list class "cellspec" components: whole slide carries 1,000 numeric features millions cells. double matrix stores compactly maps directly assay SpatialExperiment; cells stays data frame holds mixed types. Accessors return plain data frames. Rows measurements aligned cells position; row names used.
code: x <- cs_example() x #> <cellspec> spec 1.0.0 #>   cells     80 in 2 images (2 samples) #>   features  19: 16 intensity, 2 shape, 1 other #>   markers   4: DAPI, CD3e, Pan-Cytokeratin, FOXP3 #>   pixel     0.5 um/px #>   adjacency none #>   source    simulate 1.0.0 (cellspecR simulator 1.0.0)

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: Rules: key (image_id, cell_id) MUST unique. x y MUST finite. area, present, MUST positive NA. Identifiers character columns, never row names. Additional columns allowed snake_case. prefixes region__ boundary_distance__ reserved region annotations cs__ internal use. layer name MUST match ^[-Za-z0-9][-Za-z0-9_.-]*$. cells MUST contain clinical variables; subject_id belongs images.

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: double matrix one row per cell. Column names feature identifiers MUST equal dictionary$feature_id, order. Values kept exported source tool, raw units. transformation applied import. NaN infinite values sources converted NA counted provenance$counts.

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: Controlled vocabularies: kind: intensity, shape, . compartment: cell, nucleus, cytoplasm, membrane, NA features. statistic intensity features: mean, median, sd, min, max, sum, variance. statistic shape features: area, perimeter, length, circularity, solidity, max_diameter, min_diameter, max_caliper, min_caliper, eccentricity, major_axis_length, minor_axis_length, extent, orientation, nucleus_cell_area_ratio. Unknown shape measurements stored kind = "", never dropped. unit: .u., um, um2, px, px2, rad, 1. Feature identifiers generated readers follow one rule per kind: Downstream code MUST select features dictionary columns, example cs_features(), splitting identifiers. Marker names MUST trimmed MUST contain :. identifiers follow rule unique, two features can describe kind, marker, compartment statistic.
code: cs_features(x, kind = "intensity", marker = "FOXP3") #> [1] "cell:FOXP3:mean"      "cell:FOXP3:median"    "nucleus:FOXP3:mean"   #> [4] "nucleus:FOXP3:median"

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: Every intensity marker dictionary MUST appear channels$marker every image object. channel without measurements allowed, example nuclear stain used segmentation.

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: provenance list least fields: Input paths stored file names plus hash. Full paths leak private directory structures stored user explicitly asks .

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: method one mask_touching, polygon_intersection, delaunay. unordered pair cells appears , ordered cell_id_a sorts cell_id_b byte order, cells MUST exist cells. Subsetting object drops contacts whose cells removed.

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: origin top-left corner top-left full-resolution pixel; x increases right y increases downward (QuPath convention). centre pixel 0-based index lies (+ 0.5) * pixel_size. Centroids x y micrometres. Readers receive pixel centroids MUST know pixel size, file argument, MUST stop otherwise. tool reports micrometre pixel centroids, readers check abs(x - x_px * pixel_size) <= 0.5 * pixel_size stop disagreement. micro sign appears exports U+00B5, U+03BC, um mis-decoded Âµ. Readers normalise variants matching headers keep original header source_name.

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: cellspec directory holds one object disk: cell table stored Parquet default, keeps every double bit-exact. tab-separated alternative (cells.tsv.gz, adjacency.tsv.gz) readable tool; numbers carry 15 significant digits, values can differ originals last representable digits. cellspec.json validates JSON Schema shipped system.file("schema", "cellspec-1.0.0.schema.json", package = "cellspecR"). Writers stage directory temporary name rename end, directory without DONE completely written. Readers refuse directory without DONE, manifest mismatch, unsupported major spec_version.
code: <dir>/   cells.parquet       cells columns, then one column per feature_id   cellspec.json       spec_version, column types, dictionary, images,                       channels, provenance   adjacency.parquet   optional   MANIFEST.sha256     "<sha256>  <relative path>" for every file above   DONE                written last; holds the SHA-256 of MANIFEST.sha256

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: cs_validate() checks object rules . Structure checks implement MUST rules fail; semantic checks flag implausible content warn.

title: The cellspec 1.0 format
text: spec_version follows semantic versioning. Minor versions add optional columns components. reader major version 1 accepts every 1.y object whose minor version newer . Readers tool exports carry adapter_version, changes whenever output input changes.

title: Create a cellspec object — cs_new
text: Builds cellspec object components checks structure rules specification. Tool exports normally read cs_read(); use cs_new() already hold pieces memory, example another package produces cell tables. Inputs normalised validation: data frame subclass becomes plain data.frame without row names, factors become character vectors, identifier columns (cell_id, image_id, sample_id, subject_id) converted character, whole-number doubles integer columns become integers, NaN/Inf measurements become NA (counted provenance$counts$nonfinite_converted). missing sample_id column cells filled images.

NULL means features. dictionary data frame describing measurement column (see cs_vocabulary()). NULL allowed features. images data frame one row per image least image_id, sample_id pixel_size. channels data frame one row per image channel (image_id, channel_index, channel_name, marker), NULL intensity features exist. provenance list describing origin data. Missing fields filled defaults; NULL records object built cs_new(). adjacency Optional data frame cell-cell contacts (image_id, cell_id_a, cell_id_b, shared_boundary, method).

title: Validate a cellspec object — cs_validate
text: cs_validate() checks object cellspec specification returns report one row per check. cs_assert_valid() runs checks aborts check fails. level = "structure" runs MUST rules specification: required columns types, unique keys, finite centroids, dictionary vocabulary, alignment measurements, channels optional adjacency. failing structure check means packages rely object. level = "semantic" adds plausibility checks produce warnings, failures: centroids outside image, implausible cell areas, negative intensities, features many missing values, markers without usable signal (cs_feature_support()) duplicated centroids, usually indicate cells counted twice tiles merged.

title: Validate a cellspec object — cs_validate
code: cs_validate(   x,   level = c("structure", "semantic"),   area_range = c(1, 5000),   na_max = 0.01 )  cs_assert_valid(x, level = "structure", call = rlang::caller_env())

title: Validate a cellspec object — cs_validate
text: x cellspec object. level "structure" "semantic" (structure plus semantic checks). area_range Numeric vector length 2: plausible whole-cell area square micrometres area_range check. na_max Largest acceptable fraction missing values per feature feature_na_fraction check. call execution environment used error messages; internal callers pass .

title: Validate a cellspec object — cs_validate
text: cs_validate() returns data frame class cellspec_validation one row per check columns check (character), level ("structure" "semantic"), status ("pass", "warn", "fail", "skip" prerequisite check failed), n (integer number offending rows, features values) message (character, naming columns features five examples). Rows catalogue order; print() shows failures first. cs_assert_valid() returns x invisibly, aborts error class cellspec_error_invalid whose report field holds report.

title: Validate a cellspec object — cs_validate
code: x <- cs_example() cs_validate(x) #> <cellspec validation> 45 checks: 0 fail, 0 warn, 0 skip, 45 pass #> pass 45 other checks report <- cs_validate(x, level = "semantic") report[report$status != "pass", ] #> <cellspec validation> 0 checks: 0 fail, 0 warn, 0 skip, 0 pass  # A broken object fails with a classed error bad <- x bad$cells$x[1] <- NA try(cs_assert_valid(bad)) #> Error in eval(expr, envir) :  #>   `x` is not a valid <cellspec> object (1 failing check). #> ✖ cells_coordinates_finite: 1 cell with a missing or non-finite `x` or `y`, #>   e.g. "img1/1".

title: cellspecR (development version)
text: Header-TSV exports now write complete gzip stream, including empty cell adjacency tables. declared column types survive read-back. QuPath readers recognize compartment-first cell area nuclear morphology explicit units. Whole-cell area kept separately nuclear area; shape dictionaries retain original headers dimensional units. segmantR reader converts one-based pixel-index centroid means image’s pixel-edge coordinate frame converts pixel area square micrometres. Unrecognized centroid conventions rejected. Crop, pyramid anisotropic transforms must handled explicitly image integration. Raw shape measurements retain pixel radian units.
